decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham is a close extension of the established offer in a growing segment, so results likely meet aspiration and slack allows keeping it.
Organic sliced cured smoked pork is similarly close to the firm's core and benefits from the organic trend, so no shortfall triggers search.
Organic pepper-coated salami is an incremental line extension with likely satisfactory results given the firm's slack and industry growth.
Beef in teriyaki aspic is more exotic and uncertain, but the firm's slack and lack of recorded shortfall make it reasonable to keep and monitor.
Fennel-flavoured sliced salami is a taste variation close to the established range, and without signs of underperformance it meets the aspiration to keep.
Liver pâté with veal leverages established recipes and fits the premium delicatessen offer, so satisfactory results and slack support keeping it.
